entries.title: Isaiah 34:1
segments: ¶Come near, you nations, to hear; And heed, you people! Let the earth hear, and all that is in it, The world and all things that come forth from it.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:2
segments: For the indignation of the LORD [is] against all nations, And [His] fury against all their armies; He has utterly destroyed them, He has given them over to the slaughter.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:3
segments: Also their slain shall be thrown out; Their stench shall rise from their corpses, And the mountains shall be melted with their blood.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:4
segments: All the host of heaven shall be dissolved, And the heavens shall be rolled up like a scroll; All their host shall fall down As the leaf falls from the vine, And as [fruit] falling from a fig tree.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:5
segments: "For My sword shall be bathed in heaven; Indeed it shall come down on Edom, And on the people of My curse, for judgment.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:6
segments: The sword of the LORD is filled with blood, It is made overflowing with fatness, With the blood of lambs and goats, With the fat of the kidneys of rams. For the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, And a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:7
segments: The wild oxen shall come down with them, And the young bulls with the mighty bulls; Their land shall be soaked with blood, And their dust saturated with fatness."

entries.title: Isaiah 34:8
segments: For [it is] the day of the LORD'S vengeance, The year of recompense for the cause of Zion.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:9
segments: ¶Its streams shall be turned into pitch, And its dust into brimstone; Its land shall become burning pitch.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:10
segments: It shall not be quenched night or day; Its smoke shall ascend forever. From generation to generation it shall lie waste; No one shall pass through it forever and ever.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:11
segments: But the pelican and the porcupine shall possess it, Also the owl and the raven shall dwell in it. And He shall stretch out over it The line of confusion and the stones of emptiness.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:12
segments: They shall call its nobles to the kingdom, But none [shall be] there, and all its princes shall be nothing.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:13
segments: And thorns shall come up in its palaces, Nettles and brambles in its fortresses; It shall be a habitation of jackals, A courtyard for ostriches.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:14
segments: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the jackals, And the wild goat shall bleat to its companion; Also the night creature shall rest there, And find for herself a place of rest.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:15
segments: There the arrow snake shall make her nest and lay [eggs] And hatch, and gather [them] under her shadow; There also shall the hawks be gathered, Every one with her mate.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:16
segments: "Search from the book of the LORD, and read: Not one of these shall fail; Not one shall lack her mate. For My mouth has commanded it, and His Spirit has gathered them.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:17
segments: He has cast the lot for them, And His hand has divided it among them with a measuring line. They shall possess it forever; From generation to generation they shall dwell in it."
